packs.subject: history
packs.displayName: KS3 History - The Black Death
packs.grammarFocusEn: Key terms, dates, causes, symptoms, beliefs, treatments and consequences for KS3 revision on the Black Death

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Coasts
packs.grammarFocusEn: Coastal geography: waves (constructive/destructive), erosion, transportation, deposition; coastal landforms (cliffs, stacks, beaches, spits, bars); hard and soft engineering management.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Coasts: Waves, Landforms and Management
packs.grammarFocusEn: Coastal processes: waves (constructive/destructive), erosion (hydraulic action, abrasion, attrition, solution), transportation, deposition; landforms (headlands, bays, cliffs, wave-cut platforms, caves, arches, stacks, stumps, beaches, spits, bars); coastal management (hard and soft engineering).

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Development and Globalisation
packs.grammarFocusEn: Development and globalisation: HDI, GNI, development gap, global trade, TNCs, aid types, Fairtrade, migration and interdependence.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Ecosystems
packs.grammarFocusEn: Ecosystems: biomes, food webs, nutrient cycling; tropical rainforest, hot desert, tundra; ecosystem services and threats.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Energy Resources
packs.grammarFocusEn: Energy resources: renewable and non-renewable sources; energy mix; fossil fuels, nuclear, solar, wind, HEP; energy security and sustainable development.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Geographical Skills
packs.grammarFocusEn: Maps, grid references, scale, contour lines, compass directions, OS symbols; graphs and data presentation; field sketches; GIS; latitude and longitude.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Glaciation
packs.grammarFocusEn: Glaciation: formation of glaciers, erosion processes (freeze-thaw, plucking, abrasion); erosional landforms (corrie, arête, U-shaped valley); depositional landforms (moraine, drumlin).

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: Ks3 Geography Glaciation 1

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Glaciation 2
packs.grammarFocusEn: Revision pack on key depositional landforms created by glaciers and the ways glacial landscapes are used and managed. It covers moraines, drumlins and erratics, then links these physical features to tourism, conflict and sustainable management in glacial areas.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Glaciation (Consolidated)
packs.grammarFocusEn: Glaciation: formation, accumulation, ablation, firn; erosion (freeze-thaw, plucking, abrasion); erosional landforms (corrie, tarn, arete, pyramidal peak, U-shaped valley, ribbon lake, hanging valley, truncated spur); depositional landforms (moraine, drumlin, erratic); tourist management and sustainable tourism.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Industry and Economic Activity
packs.grammarFocusEn: Industry and economic activity: primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary sectors; industrial location factors; deindustrialisation; TNCs; global supply chains.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Population and Migration
packs.grammarFocusEn: Population and migration: population growth, birth/death rates, demographic transition model; push/pull factors; types of migration; urbanisation and rural-urban migration.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Regional Studies
packs.grammarFocusEn: Regional studies: physical and human characteristics of world regions; comparing MEDCs and LEDCs; case studies of contrasting regions.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Rivers
packs.grammarFocusEn: River processes and landforms: erosion (hydraulic action, abrasion, attrition, solution), transportation, deposition; landforms (V-shaped valley, waterfall, meander, ox-bow lake, flood plain, delta); flooding and management.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Rocks and Geology 1
packs.grammarFocusEn: Rock types: igneous (intrusive/extrusive), sedimentary, metamorphic; the rock cycle; weathering (physical, chemical, biological); erosion, transportation, deposition.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Settlements
packs.grammarFocusEn: Settlement patterns (nucleated, dispersed, linear); site and situation; settlement hierarchy; urbanisation; land use zones; push and pull factors; counter-urbanisation; sustainable urban development.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Tectonic Hazards
packs.grammarFocusEn: Tectonic hazards: plate tectonics, plate boundaries (constructive, destructive, conservative, collision); volcanoes, earthquakes, tsunamis; causes, effects and management.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — UK Geography
packs.grammarFocusEn: UK geography: physical regions, climate, rivers and coasts; population distribution; urban and rural land use; economic activities; environmental issues.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Water Resources
packs.grammarFocusEn: Water resources: the water cycle; water supply and demand; water insecurity; dams, reservoirs, water transfer schemes; sustainable water management.

packs.subject: geography
packs.displayName: KS3 Geography — Weather and Climate
packs.grammarFocusEn: Weather and climate: atmospheric processes, pressure systems, air masses, UK weather patterns; climate zones; climate change — causes, evidence and impacts.

packs.subject: language
packs.displayName: Cambridge Latin Stages 1-12
packs.grammarFocusEn: Stage-based Latin to English and English to Latin vocabulary practice

packs.subject: science
packs.displayName: KS3 Science - Biology: Organisation
packs.grammarFocusEn: A KS3 biology revision pack about how multicellular organisms are organised and how key human body systems work together. It covers specialised cells, tissues, organs, digestion, enzymes, food tests, gas exchange, respiration and working scientifically skills.
